content: Vercel AI SDK (package 'ai', v7.x) generateObject/generateText support Zod-schema structured output and tool calling; it is a plain npm package usable in any Node runtime including Firebase Cloud Functions v2 onCall, not tied to Vercel hosting. Firebase's own Genkit (with onCallGenkit) is the Google-native alternative with built-in Zod export and tracing, commonly combined ('Genkit server-side, AI SDK client-side') but either works standalone in Cloud Functions.
